coverage_override.reason: The Xyz material requirement, self-protection, Battle-Phase ATK effect, and leave-field summon/protection effect are the four individual mechanics.

effects.lua_implementation: The standard Xyz procedure requires exactly three Level 1 monsters that each have TYPE_TUNER.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz procedures encode an exact material level, count, and material filter.

effects.printed_clause: This Xyz Summoned card cannot be targeted by card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: While this card remains Xyz Summoned in the Monster Zone, EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET now has value 1, prohibiting targeting by either player's card effects.

official_references.card_name: Number C88: Gimmick Puppet Disaster Leo
official_references.matched_structure: Official unqualified 'cannot be targeted by card effects' protection uses EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with SetValue(1).

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: aux.tgoval protects only against the opponent. The unqualified text prohibits both players from targeting this card.

effects.printed_clause: Once per Battle Phase, at the start of the Battle Phase: You can banish 1 material from this card and the top 4 cards of your Deck; make this card's ATK become equal to the number of all banished cards times 200.
effects.lua_implementation: The phase-start trigger banishes one removable overlay and exactly four removable top Deck cards as cost, then permanently sets ATK to both players' current banished-card count times 200. The turn-wide SetCountLimit was removed, allowing the distinct start event of a second Battle Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Official start-of-Battle-Phase effects register EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_BATTLE_START and perform their Battle Phase operation from that phase event.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: SetCountLimit(1) resets per turn, not per Battle Phase, so it wrongly blocked use at the start of a second Battle Phase in the same turn. The phase-start event itself provides one trigger opportunity per Battle Phase.

effects.printed_clause: If this Xyz Summoned card with material leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 of your banished Level 4 or lower FIRE Fiend monsters, and if you do, it cannot be targeted by card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed leave-field trigger checks previous Monster Zone, Xyz Summon type, and prior overlay count, summons a face-up banished Level 4 or lower FIRE Fiend, and now grants that monster targeting protection from both players.

official_references.matched_structure: Official leave-field Xyz effects inspect prior Xyz Summon state and prior overlay count.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unqualified targeting protection grants EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with value 1.
